finding: The hybrid over post quantum only ratio of 1.12 to 1.14 and the conclusion that the X25519 part is cheap are artefacts of ML-DSA-44 signing variance over five runs, not a property of the designs. Hybrid and post quantum only differ deterministically by two X25519 scalar multiplications (6.32 M cycles on CV32E40P), which is more than half of the ML-DSA-44 verify plus median sign (3.90 M + 7.41 M). The post quantum only median happens to fall on runs with many signing rejections.
note: 15 runs, ratios with intervals and from primitive sums; the paper explains the spread by ML-DSA-44 signing and drops the claim that X25519 is cheap

finding: The hybrid over classical ratios 1.76 (CV32E40P) and 1.90 (Ibex) are ratios of medians of five runs, where the hybrid side is dominated by the data dependent number of ML-DSA-44 signing rounds and the classical side is nearly constant.
